rows.grounds: Compound adjective: sva-rūpa-jñāna (own-form-knowledge) + possessive suffix -vat; describes the qualified recipient.

items.question: What qualification of self-knowledge defines the worthy recipient of transmission?
premises: Knowledge of one's own nature is the required quality.
This quality marks fitness for receiving the teaching.
items.inference: Only one who knows their own true nature is a fit recipient for transmission.
items.plain_english: One who possesses knowledge of his own true nature.
